components.name: WhatsApp Action
components.description: Direct product-and-branch WhatsApp anchor; the destination is resolved by the app.
components.css: .ds-whatsapp-action { display:inline-flex; min-height:3rem; align-items:center; justify-content:center; border-radius:9999px; background:#28211c; padding:0.5rem 1.25rem; color:#fffaf1; font-family:var(--font-body, Manrope),ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:0.875rem; font-weight:700; text-align:center; text-decoration:none; transition:transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-whatsapp-action:hover { transform:translateY(-0.125rem); } .ds-whatsapp-action:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #845422; outline-offset:2px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-whatsapp-action { transition:none; } }

components.name: Hero Action
components.description: Soft-bronze product jump link inside the dark public hero.
components.css: .ds-hero-action { display:inline-flex; min-height:3rem; align-items:center; border-radius:9999px; background:#f3dfb9; padding:0 1.5rem; color:#352720; font-family:var(--font-body, Manrope),ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:0.875rem; font-weight:700; text-decoration:none; transition:transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-hero-action:hover { transform:translateY(-0.125rem); } .ds-hero-action:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #f3dfb9; outline-offset:2px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-hero-action { transition:none; } }

components.name: Gallery Card
components.description: Independent 4:5 branch-gallery image with optional editorial caption.
components.css: .ds-gallery-card { overflow:hidden; margin:0; border-radius:1rem; background:#fffdf9; color:#28211c; font-family:var(--font-body, Manrope),ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-gallery-media { aspect-ratio:4/5; background:linear-gradient(145deg,#eee5d8,#ded2c1); } .ds-gallery-caption { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:0.25rem; padding:1rem; } .ds-gallery-caption strong { font-family:var(--font-display, 'Bricolage Grotesque'),ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif; font-weight:700; } .ds-gallery-caption span { color:#675c51; font-size:0.875rem; line-height:1.5; }

components.name: Secondary Link
components.description: Public secondary destination that stays subordinate to WhatsApp.
components.css: .ds-secondary-link { display:flex; min-height:4rem; align-items:center; border-radius:1rem; background:#fffdf9; padding:0.75rem 1.25rem; color:#28211c; font-family:var(--font-body, Manrope),ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif; font-weight:700; text-decoration:none; transition:background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-secondary-link:hover { background:#f3dfb9; } .ds-secondary-link:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #845422; outline-offset:2px; }

components.description: Admin dashboard link for the current site identity.

components.css: .ds-dark-summary { display:flex; min-height:11rem; flex-direction:column; justify-content:space-between; border-radius:1rem; background:#352720; padding:1.5rem; color:#fffaf1; font-family:var(--font-body, Manrope),ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif; text-decoration:none; transition:transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-dark-summary:hover { transform:translateY(-0.25rem); } .ds-dark-summary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #845422; outline-offset:2px; } .ds-summary-label { color:#f0e7db; font-size:0.875rem; font-weight:600; } .ds-summary-value { display:block; margin-top:1rem; font-family:var(--font-display, 'Bricolage Grotesque'),ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:1.5rem; line-height:1.25; font-weight:700; overflow-wrap:anywhere; } .ds-summary-action { margin-top:1.5rem; color:#f3dfb9; font-size:0.875rem; font-weight:700; } .ds-dark-summary:hover .ds-summary-action { text-decoration:underline; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-dark-summary { transition:none; } }

components.name: Admin Quick Link
components.description: Border-separated route in the dashboard quick-access panel.
components.css: .ds-quick-link { display:flex; min-height:2.75rem; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; border-bottom:1px solid #ded2c1; color:#28211c; font-family:var(--font-body, Manrope),ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:0.875rem; font-weight:500; text-decoration:none; } .ds-quick-link:hover { color:#845422; } .ds-quick-link:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #845422; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Admin Navigation Rail
components.description: Full-height dark icon rail with concave viewport-edge cuts and a contained ivory active state.
components.css: .ds-admin-rail { position:relative; display:flex; width:4rem; min-height:100vh; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; gap:0.5rem; padding:2.5rem 0.625rem; background:#352720; color:#f0e7db; box-shadow:0 20px 45px -32px rgba(40,33,28,0.7); } .ds-rail-cut { position:absolute; left:50%; width:2.75rem; height:2.75rem; border-radius:9999px; background:#f7f2e9; transform:translateX(-50%); } .ds-rail-cut-top { top:-1.375rem; } .ds-rail-cut-bottom { bottom:-1.375rem; } .ds-rail-separator { width:2rem; height:1px; margin:0.5rem 0; background:rgba(255,255,255,0.2); } .ds-rail-item { display:flex; width:2.75rem; height:2.75rem; flex:none; align-items:center; justify-content:center; border-radius:0.75rem; color:#f0e7db; text-decoration:none; transition:background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1),color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-rail-item svg { width:1.25rem; height:1.25rem; stroke-width:1.7; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round; } .ds-rail-item:hover { background:rgba(255,255,255,0.15); } .ds-rail-item:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #f3dfb9; outline-offset:2px; } .ds-rail-item-active { background:#fffdf9; color:#352720; box-shadow:0 8px 20px -14px rgba(0,0,0,0.8); } @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-rail-item { transition:none; } }

narrative.overview: The public Link Bio is a compact boutique choice board; the CMS is a clear working studio. Both use the owner-approved Playful SaaS direction through warm ivory, charcoal, and bronze, expressive headings, calm fields of color, and rounded modular panels. The public surface keeps products and direct branch WhatsApp actions prominent; the admin surface prioritizes scannable content state and editing routes.
keyCharacteristics: Shared warm palette across public and admin surfaces.
Unequal bento panels, softly rounded cards, and pill-shaped actions.
Branch gallery imagery is independent from product WhatsApp actions.
Shared product types are managed contextually inside each branch's WhatsApp-button panel.
State motion is light, with reduced-motion fallbacks.
dos: **Do** reuse the shared ivory, charcoal, and bronze roles across public and admin surfaces.
**Do** keep gallery imagery independent from product CTA eligibility.
**Do** keep WhatsApp actions visibly primary and directly navigable.
**Do** retain visible focus and reduced-motion treatments on interactive elements.
donts: **Don't** add a competing generic SaaS accent color or decorative treatment that outranks product choice.
**Don't** turn the public surface into a multi-step funnel before WhatsApp.
**Don't** imply every card is elevated; most observed panels are flat.
